newsitem.title: UK: Supermodel Evangelista, the new face of Yardley.
newsitem.headline: Supermodel Evangelista, the new face of Yardley.

text.p: Supermodel Linda Evangelista, renowned for her changing hairstyles and refusing to get out of bed for a fee of less than $10,000, has been signed on as the new face of Yardley.
The British fragance company said Monday the 27-year-old Canadian catwalk queen would launch Yardley's new perfume, "Baroque," and promote its other cosmetics.
Yardley has refused to comment on how much Evangelista, one of the most highly paid models in the world, will earn.
"Linda Evangelista is our new face," a spokeswoman for Yardley said.
Managing Director Richard Finn said the company would use Evangelista's chameleon qualities to exploit the different "personalities" of its brands.

"The company now competes in all major markets, and it is therefore important that we use an internationally recognised face. Linda is universally acknowledged as the first, and possibly the best, of the supermodels," Finn said in a statement.
Yardley, owned by U.S. investment house Wasserstein Perella, has previously promoted its products with the image of the English rose.
Its last face was British actress Helena Bonham-Carter, famous for her performances in period costume dramas, who stepped down from her 500,000 pound ($780,000) a-year position.

Evangelista is the latest in a line of models and actresses who have clinched lucrative deals with major cosmetic and fashion companies. British model Elizabeth Hurley signed a multi-million dollar contract last year with make-up giant Estee Lauder.
